configCard.notExposed.title: Config namespace {ns} is not exposed to the web
configCard.notExposed.body: The harness web gateway only exposes whitelisted settings namespaces to the settings panel (WEB_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES); this namespace is not on the list, so `settings.describe` answers settings-not-exposed. The host half is unaffected: the greet tool still reads config live.
configCard.notExposed.remedy: To make this card editable: add {ns} to the harness WEB_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES list and rebuild/restart the harness; or wait for the harness to move the exposure declaration into settings.register() (deferred work noted in source).
